one_liner: Built a responsive, component-driven web experience for Tanger's outlet retail destinations and promotions.
projectSummary: Developed flexible, responsive UI components for Tanger’s retail and brand ecosystem, supporting new layouts, interactive modules, and marketing-driven content updates.

problem.summary: Tanger needed a modernized digital experience that strengthened brand presentation, improved clarity across retail pages, and enabled flexible, content-driven updates for marketing and promotional modules.

goals: Build flexible, reusable components for retail and marketing modules
Improve responsiveness and layout consistency across breakpoints
Collaborate with design to refine interaction and visual polish
Increase visual and structural consistency across the platform
responsibilities: Developed React components aligned with detailed Figma specifications
Created reusable UI patterns for retail content and promotional modules
Implemented responsive behavior across multiple device sizes
Collaborated with designers on layout, spacing, and interaction details
Ensured accessibility and visual consistency across components
Integrated components with backend-driven dynamic content
outcomes: Delivered flexible UI modules reused across Tanger’s retail and brand pages
Improved clarity, consistency, and responsiveness across the platform
Enabled faster, more reliable iteration on marketing and promotional content
